_note: W-DRAWN-MAINS data rows (prompts/DISC_WALK_DRAWN_MAINS.md section 4.3). Row shape {discipline, role, pattern, standard, source}, so it can become a DB table without a shape change. layer roles: centreline, outline, fitting, grid_line, grid_tag (pattern = case-insensitive regex on the DXF layer name); terminal_<system> rows: pattern = a name word matched inside an INSERT block name. Ducts (ACMV) only: no FP or PLB rows until pipe layers are measured (section 8). Layer patterns follow the US National CAD Standard (spec 4.3 amendments 2); fitting = an INSERT on the outline layer (entity INSERT); terminal_layer = diffuser inserts; the terminal words were tested on one set only (section 4.6). No existing word store maps terminal names to a system (grep of modeller/, viewer/, common/ 2026-11-08: viewer/import_worker.js maps names to a discipline only), so the terminal words live here.
